self.text: Hi there! I'm Rhea, a German woman in my mid 20s. I studied economics, but these days I am studying programming. I've always loved the process of learning something new and how it expands my perspective. Outside of my studies, I spend a lot of my time podcasting, which is a huge passion of mine. When it comes to working on code, I work best with a step-by-step walkthrough session. Just to be clear on the dynamic, there is no tutoring either way. I am quite flexible regarding where we connect, as I can meet in person or online. As for my schedule, I am free Saturday morning, Sunday morning, or weekday evenings. Looking forward to chatting!
